excerpt.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Emb

scope.zh: 地下室移位：铁路遗迹（Relic Rails）考古遗址的发现与结局。
scope.en: Basement Shift: discovery of the Relic Rails archaeological site and its endings.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上最新建设计划被深层地陷打断了。伤亡不大，并且我们的基础设施没有受到太大影响。然而该地质活动揭露了一座地下交通网络的一角。尴尬的测量师们已经开始勘察这些突然出现的隧道。似乎这属于[From.Planet.GetName]过去的历史……
texts.en: Deep-level cave-ins have shaken our newest building project on [From.Planet.GetName]. Casualties were minimal, and none of our primary infrastructure was affected. This geological activity has, however, revealed part of a network of transportation tunnels. Embarrassed surveyors have already begun looking into their sudden appearance. It would seem [From.Planet.GetName] has a prior history...

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？
texts.en: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this region of space. Who built it, and why?

sections.zh: 最近，[From.Planet.GetName]上的地陷将其地下的交通隧道网揭露了出来。这些精致的道路和复杂的信号设施已经深埋地下数百年；它们的设计与我们之前在这片太空区域所发现的一切均不相同。究竟是谁为了什么建造了它们呢？
sections.en: Recent cave-ins on [From.Planet.GetName] have revealed a network of underground transportation tunnels. Its elaborate archways and complex signalling equipment have lain undiscovered for centuries; their design is unlike anything else we've encountered in this region of space. Who built it, and why?

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
发掘进行没多久，设计更为错综、建造更加牢靠的隧道和设备就显露了出来。宽轨铁轨与卧铺列车保存状况良好，周围还有各式各样的遗物以及扔了几个世纪的垃圾。

在这些残骸中留有各种经过精心阳极氧化处理的引擎和信号设施部件，和维修站里会有的东西一样。所有部件上都刻有精致而复杂的几何图样，或许这其中有高级的艺术技巧，甚至曾令人引以为豪。
texts.en:
It wasn't long before our excavations revealed tunnels and equipment of sturdier construction and more intricate design. Heavy-gauge rails and sleepers lie preserved and intact, surrounded by myriad relics and centuries-old garbage.

Amongst the debris lie various precisely-anodized pieces of engine and signalling equipment, such as one might find in a maintenance depot. All are inscribed in singular detail with complex, geometric patterns - suggesting high levels of artistry and perhaps even pride.

texts.zh:
我们在对一条狭窄辅道试探性发掘时，找到了一个死去多时的爬行动物，死因是大约800年前发生的顶板塌陷。遗体出现在这条隧道里的原因一开始是个谜题，但我们在对其身上携带的许多武器进行研究后找到了答案。

发现的带刃工具中有许多挂在一顶装饰性盾牌的内侧，制造这些工具的技术和我们比起来只能算原始，但却与在隧道轨路上使用的技术明显不同。这位带着盾牌的来访者如同我们一样，并不属于这颗星球，而且看起来还在进行与我们类似的考古研究，直至在隧道中丧生为止。
texts.en:
Our chance excavation of a narrow side-tunnel has revealed a long-dead reptilian occupant, whose demise by ceiling collapse dates back some 800 years. Their presence in this tunnel was something of a puzzle, solved only when we completed a study of the many weapons found on their person.

The technology underlying these bladed implements - many of which were mounted on the inside of a decorative targe - is primitive compared to our own, yet markedly different to that used on the railroad. This targe-bearing visitor was as alien to this world as we are, and they seem to have been conducting similar archaeological research - that is, before the tunnel claimed their life.

texts.zh:
负盾者的记录把我们带到了一座变电站，这座变电站曾经用于维持这个维修场。看起来他们的探险打破了该设施的气密封印；这里很少有腐烂的迹象。布满灰尘的电缆管道在几十个监视器周围形成柱廊。正是在这样一个通道上，我们发现了残留的来自另一感性物种的遗迹。

负盾者的探险队称这是一群软体动物技术人员——他们仍然保存完好的尸体挤在一起，以相互保护或取暖。记录中还记录了两次试图重新启动这个有千年历史的变电站的尝试，但使用的工具都不如我们的。我们有机会完成这项工作，这样做会使进一步的挖掘工作更容易。
texts.en:
The Targe-bearer's notes have led us to an electrical substation which once served this maintenance yard. It looks like their expedition broke an atmospheric seal on the facility; there are comparatively few signs of decay here. Dust-covered cable ducts form colonnades around dozens of monitors. It is down one such aisle of monitors that we found trace remains from sentients of a different species.

The Targe-bearer's expedition described this as a group of molluscoid technicians - their still-preserved bodies huddled together for mutual protection or warmth. The records also note two attempts to restart the millennia-old substation, using tools which are inferior to ours. There's a chance we could complete this effort - and in so doing, make further excavation much easier.

texts.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外“改造”暴露了一条长距离的铁路隧道，根据我们破译的控制面板，一列火车躺在那里，隐藏在侧边。同时，这个系统也对列车应用了不同的优先级标记，包括一个我们称之为“仓库”的词。

因为很少有一个关键的人工制品以这样大的形式出现在我们面前，我们派去一个团队让火车再次启动。古董火车头本身就是一件足够优雅的工程，但它背后每一辆精心装饰的汽车都被证明是一座博物馆。

火车最好被理解为一个漫游的时间胶囊，随时准备被移动到安全的地方。三千年来，它保存了整个现在我们知道他们管自己叫做叫做皮耶普的文化的历史、文化和科学记录。
texts.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site exposed a long-distance rail tunnel down which - according to the control panels we deciphered - a train lay, tucked away in sidings. Those same systems had applied various priority markers to the train, including a word we've identified as 'repository.'

A team was dispatched to get the train moving again, for rarely does a key artifact come to us in a form as large as this. The antique locomotive is an elegant enough piece of engineering in itself, but every one of the elaborately-decorated cars behind it has proven to be a museum in its own right.

The train may best be described as a roaming time capsule, ever ready to be moved out of harm's way. For 3,000 years it has preserved the historical, cultural and scientific records of an entire culture, whom we now learn called themselves the Peeyeps.

label.zh: 带回这些记录回我们的母星作进一步研究。
label.en: Bring these records back to our homeworld for further study.

texts.zh:
来自[From.From.Planet.GetName]的铁路建造者留下的记录告诉我们这群狂热的软体动物是如何逃离他们对恐惧科技的家园，通过机械化的努力来寻求更好的自我。他们撤退到一个神秘而遥远的地下洞穴网络，后来通过铁路隧道连接和扩大了它们的栖息地。

由于担心他们的文化有一天会被猎杀和消灭，皮耶普人为了安全在地下修建。在接下来的200年里，他们的社会发展缓慢，在此期间，他们的家乡的政府变得更加孤立和偏执。一次激进的转变就促使他们以前所未有的规模进行军事化；就在这时，编年史突然结束了。

即使有了随后的负盾者自己不完整的发现，我们也只能推测两国人民的悲惨命运。进一步的考古证据要么丢失了，要么没有记录下来；现在唯一剩下的就是他们的隧道，他们的记录和他们的火车。
texts.en:
The records left by the railroad-builders of [From.From.Planet.GetName] tell how this fervent band of molluscoids fled their technophobic homeland, seeking to better themselves through mechanical endeavor. They retreated to a secret and distant network of underground caves, later linking and expanding their habitats by means of railroad tunnels.

Fearful that their very culture may one day be hunted and eradicated, the Peeyeps built deep - for security and preservation. Their society grew slowly over the next 200 years, during which time their homeland's government turned more insular and paranoid. A single, radical swing provoked them into militarization on an unprecedented scale; at this point the chronicle ends abruptly.

Even with the Targe-bearer's own subsequent, patchy findings, we can only speculate upon the tragic fates of both peoples. Further archaeological evidence has either been lost or gone unrecorded; all that remains of the Peeyeps now are their tunnels, their records and their trains.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that planet appears here.

texts.zh:
我们对这个挖掘地点的意外改造暴露了一个货场，它是从一个巨大的拱形洞穴屋顶下凿出来的。在它众多巨大而空无一人的仓库中，只有留下了一个安全封条没有启封；在重新打开的时候，我们发现了更多的负盾者的尸体。他们来这里寻找补给，却与一个有千年历史的警报系统发生冲突。

根据他们留下的日志，这个巡回的芬鲁尼尔远征队正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]是否为宜居世界。他们没有料到会在这里发现废墟。由于没有受过训练，对考古学也不感兴趣，他们对遗址进行了彻底的搜查，而不是进行调查。

那些在仓库里挨饿的人用特别生动的语言指出，他们的同志把大量的物资运到货船上，几乎没留下什么。我们自己的调查证实，尽管有大量的古董机器，但几乎没有什么东西能告诉我们这些神秘的铁路建造者是谁。
texts.en:
Our accidental remodelling of this dig site has exposed a goods yard, hewn from under a vast and vaulted cave roof. Of its many vast and vacant warehouses, only one had its security seals tripped; upon re-opening it we found the remains of more of the Targe-bearer's people. They had come seeking supplies, only to fall foul of a millennia-old alarm system.

According to the logs they left behind, this itinerant 'Fenrunir Expeditionary Group' was investigating [From.Planet.GetName] as part of a habitable worlds survey. They hadn't anticipated finding ruins here. Untrained and uninterested in archaeology, they ransacked the site rather than investigating it.

Those who met with starvation inside the warehouse note - in particularly colorful language - that their comrades removed a great deal of material to their freighters, leaving little behind. Our own surveys confirm that although there is an abundance of antique machinery, little else remains to tell us who the enigmatic railroad-builders were.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
这个变电站遗迹的复杂性让我们吃惊。我们用一台便携式相位发生器启动了它，但随之而来的爆炸活动导致我们周围有千年历史的建筑部分坍塌。

幸运的是，我们的队伍得到了足够的预警，找到了避险处。他们发现一些地区现在已经被完全封锁，但一些新的地区已经取而代之地开放。
texts.en:
This relic of a substation has surprised us with its complexity. We jump-started it using a portable phase generator, but the ensuing burst of activity caused parts of the millennia-old structure around us to collapse.

Fortunately our team had sufficient warning to find shelter. They emerged to find some areas now firmly closed off, but some new areas have opened in their stead.

texts.zh:
就在我们利用一台便携式相位发生器，从[From.Planet.GetName]上启动变电站的几分钟后，该设施突然响起刺耳的警报。几秒钟后，就在我们的挖掘小组工作的地方，部分天花板和铁路旁边的一段墙壁坍塌了。

故障已经被追踪到一个我们以为它是不相连的腐蚀的电阻器线圈。这一疏忽造成了几人受伤，并决定了我们挖掘队十多名队员的命运；他们现在正步上了负盾者的悲惨的后尘。
texts.en:
Mere minutes after we jump-started the substation on [From.Planet.GetName] using a portable phase generator, the facility erupted with piercing alarms. Seconds later, part of the ceiling and a section of wall adjoining the railroad collapsed, right where our excavation team was working.

The fault has been traced to a corroded resistor coil, which we'd thought disconnected. This oversight caused several injuries and has sealed the fates of a dozen members of our dig team; they now follow in the Targe-bearer's tragic footsteps.

note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 地下室位移 / Basement Shift

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 建筑完成时（on_building_complete）隐藏 federations3.1000：已安装远古遗物DLC，玩家非AI，全局没有人触发过铁路遗址；星球为未超3000人口的殖民地（非首都/栖息地/环世界等），刚建好的建筑是豪华住宅/集体住房/无人机仓库/蜂巢兵营之一。通过后 1/26 概率3天后触发 1005。
  When a building completes (on_building_complete) hidden federations3.1000: Ancient Relics installed, a non-AI player, nobody has triggered the Relic Rails dig site globally; the planet is a colony under 3000 pops (not capital, habitat, ring …) and the building just completed is a luxury residence / communal housing / drone storage / hive warren. It then has a 1/26 chance of 1005 after 3 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1005「地下室移位」→ 遗址“铁路遗迹”：阶段事件 1010「车库存货」、1015「武装访客」、1020「持盾者」→ 1022「驶向另一条轨道」（83%）/1021「悲剧线圈」（17%）；1026「重新服役」（83%，经修正）→ 1030「铁轨与庇护所」/1027「空空如也的棚屋」（17%）。
  1005 "Basement Shift" -> the "Relic Rails" site: stage events 1010 "Depot Deposits", 1015 "The Well-Armed Visitor", 1020 "The Targe-Bearer" -> 1022 "Onto a Different Track" (83%) / 1021 "Tragic Coil" (17%); 1026 "Back in Service" (83%, modified) -> 1030 "Rails and Refuge" / 1027 "Naught But Empty Sheds" (17%).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1022 与 1021 互斥；1026 与 1027 互斥。
  1022 and 1021 are exclusive; 1026 and 1027 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 遗址阶段的事件按随机选取。
  Site stage events are picked at random.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/federations_events_3.txt:454-1320`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2958`
- 已核对：触发条件、概率、阶段结果。
  Checked: trigger conditions, probabilities, stage results.
- 说明：结局引向的 ancrel.* 事件属于远古遗物故事，由其他审阅者负责。
  Note: the ancrel.* events this leads to belong to ancient-relics stories owned by another reviewer.
